ezekiel.33.p1.b1.text: and he sees the sword coming against that land and blows the ram’s horn to warn the people.

ezekiel.33.p1.b2.text: As for you, O son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel; so hear the word from My mouth and give them the warning from Me.

ezekiel.33.p1.b3.text: Our transgressions and our sins are heavy upon us, and we are wasting away because of them! How can we live?

ezekiel.33.p1.b4.text: As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that the wicked should turn from their ways and live.

ezekiel.33.p1.b5.text: Turn! Turn from your evil ways! For why should you die, O house of Israel?

ezekiel.33.p2.b1.text: Now the evening before the fugitive arrived, the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He opened my mouth

ezekiel.33.p2.b2.text: In the twelfth year of our exile, on the fifth day of the tenth month

ezekiel.33.p2.b4.text: before the man came to me in the morning. So my mouth was opened and I was no longer mute.

ezekiel.33.p2.b5.text: Abraham was only one man, yet he possessed the land. But we are many; surely the land has been given to us as a possession.

ezekiel.33.p2.b6.text: Indeed, you are to them like a singer of love songs with a beautiful voice, who skillfully plays an instrument. They hear your words but do not put them into practice.

ezekiel.33.p2.b7.text: So when it comes to pass—and surely it will come—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.
